faqs.question: What is Navrivon's typical development process?
faqs.answer: We follow a three-stage agile approach: 1) Discover & Blueprint (defining requirements and architecture), 2) Agile Sprints (regular development iterations with staging reviews), and 3) Launch & Support (deployment, scaling, and continuous system monitoring).

faqs.question: How do we get started with a project?
faqs.answer: Simply fill out our contact form or project planner widget, and select a time for an initial discovery call. We'll discuss your goals, draft a high-level timeline and technical proposal, and give you an estimated cost sheet.

faqs.question: Do you provide post-launch support and maintenance?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer reliable post-launch SLAs covering bug fixes, server maintenance, performance optimization, feature updates, and technical monitoring to ensure your product remains robust and secure.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing technical team?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We often collaborate with internal product teams to scale engineering capacity. We can lead specific feature designs, build APIs, or assist with cloud migrations and QA pipelines.

faqs.question: What technologies does Navrivon specialize in?
faqs.answer: We build with modern, production-grade tools. Our stack includes React/Next.js and Flutter for frontends, Python (FastAPI/Django) and Node.js for backend services, cloud platforms like AWS and GCP, and eCommerce tools like Shopify and custom headless setups.
